rows.before: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father's Elohim, and I will exalt him.
rows.after: Yah is my strength and song. Yah has become my salvation. This is my God, whom I will praise; my father's Elohim, whom I will exalt.

rows.before: and YHWH said, "If you will diligently listen to the voice of YHWH your God, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to YHWH’s commandments, and keep all YHWH’s statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you, which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am YHWH who heals you."
rows.after: and YHWH said, "If you will diligently listen to the voice of YHWH your God, and will do that which is right in YHWH’s eyes, and will pay attention to YHWH’s commandments, and keep all YHWH’s statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you, which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am YHWH who heals you."

rows.before: Moshe said to Elohim, "Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, 'The God of your fathers has sent me to you;' and they ask me, 'What is his name?' What should I tell them?"
rows.after: Moshe said to Elohim, "Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, 'The God of your fathers has sent me to you;' and they ask me, 'What is God’s name?' What should I tell them?"

rows.before: The anger of YHWH was kindled against them; and he departed.
rows.after: The anger of YHWH was kindled against them; and YHWH departed.

rows.before: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and disaster will happen to you in the latter days; because you will do that which is wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
rows.after: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and disaster will happen to you in the latter days; because you will do that which is wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke YHWH to anger through the work of your hands.

rows.before: When you shall father children, and children's children, and you shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make an engraved image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is wrong in the sight of YHWH your God, to provoke him to anger;
rows.after: When you shall father children, and children's children, and you shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make an engraved image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is wrong in the sight of YHWH your God, to provoke YHWH to anger;

rows.before: For what great nation is there, that has a god so near to them, as YHWH our God is whenever we call on him?
rows.after: For what great nation is there, that has a god so near to them, as YHWH our God is whenever we call on YHWH?

rows.before: I fell down before YHWH, as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water; because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing what was broken in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.
rows.after: I fell down before YHWH, as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water; because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing what was broken in the sight of YHWH, to provoke YHWH to anger.

rows.before: and you have seen all that YHWH your God has done to all these nations because of you; for YHWH your God, he it is that has fought for you.
rows.after: and you have seen all that YHWH your God has done to all these nations because of you; for YHWH your God has fought for you.

rows.before: and YHWH drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land: therefore we also will serve YHWH; for he is our God.
rows.after: and YHWH drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land: therefore we also will serve YHWH; for YHWH is our God.

rows.before: Yehoshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen you YHWH, to serve him. They said, We are witnesses.
rows.after: Yehoshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen you YHWH, to serve YHWH. They said, We are witnesses.

rows.before: When they cried out to YHWH, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Mitzrayim: and you lived in the wilderness many days.
rows.after: When they cried out to YHWH, YHWH put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Mitzrayim: and you lived in the wilderness many days.

rows.before: Yehoshua said, "Hereby you shall know that the living Elohim is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Hivite, and the Perizzite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.
rows.after: Yehoshua said, "Hereby you shall know that the living Elohim is among you, and that the living Elohim will without fail drive the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Hivite, and the Perizzite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

rows.before: They said to him, From a very far country your servants are come because of the name of YHWH your God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Mitzrayim,
rows.after: They said to him, From a very far country your servants are come because of the name of YHWH your God: for we have heard the fame of YHWH, and all that YHWH did in Mitzrayim,

rows.before: They put away the foreign gods from among them, and served YHWH; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
rows.after: They put away the foreign gods from among them, and served YHWH; and YHWH’s soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

rows.before: The children of Israel again did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, and served the Baals, and the Ashtaroth, and the gods of Aram, and the gods of Tzidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines; and they forsook YHWH, and didn't serve him.
rows.after: The children of Israel again did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, and served the Baals, and the Ashtaroth, and the gods of Aram, and the gods of Tzidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines; and they forsook YHWH, and didn't serve YHWH.

rows.before: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
rows.after: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel, and YHWH sold them into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

rows.before: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers who despoiled them; and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
rows.after: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel, and YHWH delivered them into the hands of spoilers who despoiled them, and sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

rows.before: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel; and he said, Because this nation have transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not listened to my voice;
rows.after: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel; and YHWH said, Because this nation have transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not listened to my voice;

rows.before: Therefore the anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
rows.after: Therefore the anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel, and YHWH sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

rows.before: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us; for his hand is sore on us, and on Dagon our god.
rows.after: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us; for the hand of the God of Israel is sore on us, and on Dagon our god.

rows.before: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors, and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel: peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.
rows.after: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors, and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel: peradventure the God of Israel will lighten the hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

rows.before: Shmuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, If you do return to YHWH with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to YHWH, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.
rows.after: Shmuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, If you do return to YHWH with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to YHWH, and serve YHWH only; and YHWH will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.

rows.before: Yehudah did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.
rows.after: Yehudah did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, and they provoked YHWH to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

rows.before: Moreover by the prophet Yehu the son of Hanani came the word of YHWH against Baasha, and against his house, both because of all the brokenness that he did in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Yerovam, and because he struck him.
rows.after: Moreover by the prophet Yehu the son of Hanani came the word of YHWH against Baasha, and against his house, both because of all the brokenness that he did in the sight of YHWH, to provoke YHWH to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Yerovam, and because he struck him.

rows.before: Eliyahu came near to all the people, and said, "How long will you waver between the two sides? If YHWH is Elohim, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him." The people answered him not a word.
rows.after: Eliyahu came near to all the people, and said, "How long will you waver between the two sides? If YHWH is Elohim, follow YHWH; but if Baal, then follow him." The people answered him not a word.

rows.before: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do what was broken in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.
rows.after: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do what was broken in the sight of YHWH, to provoke YHWH to anger.

rows.before: until YHWH removed Israel out of his sight, as he spoke by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Ashur to this day.
rows.after: until YHWH removed Israel out of YHWH’s sight, as YHWH spoke by all YHWH’s servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Ashur to this day.

rows.before: He made his son to pass through the fire, and practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he did much wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.
rows.after: He made his son to pass through the fire, and practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he did much wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke YHWH to anger.

rows.before: Yours, YHWH, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, YHWH, and you are exalted as head above all.
rows.after: Yours, YHWH, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the reign, YHWH, and you are exalted as head above all.

rows.before: So king Rechavam strengthened himself in Yerushalayim, and reigned: for Rechavam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Yerushalayim, the city which YHWH had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there: and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
rows.after: So king Rechavam strengthened himself in Yerushalayim, and reigned: for Rechavam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Yerushalayim, the city which YHWH had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put YHWH’s name there: and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

rows.before: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar: and there fell of the Ethiopians so many that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before YHWH, and before his army; and they carried away very much booty.
rows.after: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar: and there fell of the Ethiopians so many that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before YHWH, and before YHWH’s army; and they carried away very much booty.

rows.before: For he said to Yehudah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars; the land is yet before us, because we have sought YHWH our God; we have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
rows.after: For he said to Yehudah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars; the land is yet before us, because we have sought YHWH our God; we have sought YHWH, and YHWH has given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

rows.before: and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, Hear you me, Asa, and all Yehudah and Binyamin: YHWH is with you, while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found of you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
rows.after: and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, Hear you me, Asa, and all Yehudah and Binyamin: YHWH is with you, while you are with YHWH; and if you seek YHWH, YHWH will be found of you; but if you forsake YHWH, YHWH will forsake you.

rows.before: But when in their distress they turned to YHWH, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
rows.after: But when in their distress they turned to YHWH, the God of Israel, and sought YHWH, YHWH was found of them.

rows.before: They rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Yehoshafat stood and said, Hear me, Yehudah, and you inhabitants of Yerushalayim: believe in YHWH your God, so shall you be established; believe his prophets, so shall you prosper.
rows.after: They rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Yehoshafat stood and said, Hear me, Yehudah, and you inhabitants of Yerushalayim: believe in YHWH your God, so shall you be established; believe YHWH’s prophets, so shall you prosper.

rows.before: He set the Levites in the house of YHWH with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of Dawid, and of Gad the king's seer, and Natan the prophet; for the commandment was of YHWH by his prophets.
rows.after: He set the Levites in the house of YHWH with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of Dawid, and of Gad the king's seer, and Natan the prophet; for the commandment was of YHWH by YHWH’s prophets.

rows.before: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and practiced sorcery, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he did much wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.
rows.after: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and practiced sorcery, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he did much wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke YHWH to anger.

rows.before: Thus says Cyrus king of Paras, All the kingdoms of the earth has YHWH, the God of heavens, given me; and he has charged me to build him a house in Yerushalayim, which is in Yehudah.
rows.after: Thus says Cyrus king of Paras, All the kingdoms of the earth has YHWH, the God of heavens, given me; and YHWH has charged me to build a house for YHWH in Yerushalayim, which is in Yehudah.

rows.before: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.
rows.after: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is on all those who seek God, for good; but God’s power and wrath are against all those who forsake God.

rows.before: So we fasted and begged our God for this: and he was entreated of us.
rows.after: So we fasted and begged our God for this: and God was entreated of us.

rows.before: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from YHWH our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
rows.after: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from YHWH our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in YHWH’s holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

rows.before: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?'
rows.after: What is the Almighty, that we should serve the Almighty? What profit should we have, if we pray to the Almighty?'

rows.before: By the breath of Elohim they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
rows.after: By the breath of Elohim they perish. By the blast of Elohim’s anger are they consumed.

rows.before: even that it would please Elohim to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
rows.after: even that it would please Elohim to crush me; that Elohim would let loose Elohim’s hand, and cut me off!

rows.before: YHWH has established YHWH’s throne in the heavens. YHWH’s kingdom rules over all.
rows.after: YHWH has established YHWH’s throne in the heavens. YHWH’s reign rules over all.

rows.before: YHWH is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of YHWH's land.
rows.after: YHWH is Sovereign forever and ever! The nations will perish out of YHWH's land.

rows.before: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
rows.after: I will exalt you, my God, the Sovereign. I will praise your name forever and ever.

rows.before: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power;
rows.after: They will speak of the glory of your reign, and talk about your power;

rows.before: to make known to the human beings YHWH’s mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of YHWH’s kingdom.
rows.after: to make known to the human beings YHWH’s mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of YHWH’s reign.

rows.before: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. YHWH is faithful in all YHWH’s words, and loving in all YHWH’s deeds.
rows.after: Your reign is an everlasting reign. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. YHWH is faithful in all YHWH’s words, and loving in all YHWH’s deeds.

rows.before: Let Israel rejoice in the one who made them. Let the children of Tzion be joyful in their King.
rows.after: Let Israel rejoice in the one who made them. Let the children of Tzion be joyful in their Sovereign.

rows.before: For the kingdom is YHWH's. YHWH is the ruler over the nations.
rows.after: For the reign is YHWH's. YHWH is the ruler over the nations.

rows.before: Who is this King of glory? YHWH of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
rows.after: Who is this Sovereign of glory? YHWH of Armies is the Sovereign of glory! Selah.

rows.before: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
rows.after: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the Sovereign of glory will come in.

rows.before: Who is the King of glory? YHWH strong and mighty, YHWH mighty in battle.
rows.after: Who is the Sovereign of glory? YHWH strong and mighty, YHWH mighty in battle.

rows.before: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
rows.after: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the Sovereign of glory will come in.

rows.before: YHWH sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, YHWH sits as King forever.
rows.after: YHWH sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, YHWH sits as Sovereign forever.

rows.before: You are my King, Elohim. Command victories for Ya'akov!
rows.after: You are my Sovereign, Elohim. Command victories for Ya'akov!

rows.before: Your throne, Elohim, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
rows.after: Your throne, Elohim, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

rows.before: For YHWH Most High is awesome. YHWH is a great King over all the earth.
rows.after: For YHWH Most High is awesome. YHWH is a great Sovereign over all the earth.

rows.before: Sing praise to Elohim, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
rows.after: Sing praise to Elohim, sing praises. Sing praises to our Sovereign, sing praises.

rows.before: For Elohim is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
rows.after: For Elohim is the Sovereign of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

rows.before: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Har Tzion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
rows.after: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Har Tzion, on the north sides, the city of the great Sovereign.

rows.before: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for to you do I pray.
rows.after: Listen to the voice of my cry, my Sovereign and my God; for to you do I pray.

rows.before: They have seen your processions, Elohim, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
rows.after: They have seen your processions, Elohim, even the processions of my God, my Sovereign, into the sanctuary.

rows.before: Yet Elohim is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
rows.after: Yet Elohim is my Sovereign of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

rows.before: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, YHWH of Armies, my King, and my God.
rows.after: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, YHWH of Armies, my Sovereign, and my God.

rows.before: For YHWH is a great Elohim, a great King above all gods.
rows.after: For YHWH is a great Elohim, a great Sovereign above all gods.

rows.before: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, YHWH.
rows.after: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the Sovereign, YHWH.

rows.before: The King's strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Ya'akov.
rows.after: The Sovereign's strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Ya'akov.

rows.before: Behold, Elohim is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, YHWH, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation."
rows.after: Behold, Elohim is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, YHWH, is my strength and song; and YHWH has become my salvation."

rows.before: Sing to YHWH, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
rows.after: Sing to YHWH, for YHWH has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

rows.before: It will be for a sign and for a witness to YHWH of Armies in the land of Mitzrayim; for they will cry to YHWH because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.
rows.after: It will be for a sign and for a witness to YHWH of Armies in the land of Mitzrayim; for they will cry to YHWH because of oppressors, and YHWH will send them a savior and a defender, and deliver them.

rows.before: YHWH will strike Mitzrayim, striking and healing. They will return to YHWH, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
rows.after: YHWH will strike Mitzrayim, striking and healing. They will return to YHWH, and YHWH will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

rows.before: It shall be said in that day, "Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is YHWH! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!"
rows.after: It shall be said in that day, "Behold, this is our God! We have waited for God, and God will save us! This is YHWH! We have waited for YHWH. We will be glad and rejoice in YHWH’s salvation!"

rows.before: For, behold, YHWH comes forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
rows.after: For, behold, YHWH comes forth out of YHWH’s place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

rows.before: For YHWH is our judge. YHWH is our lawgiver. YHWH is our king. YHWH will save us.
rows.after: For YHWH is our judge. YHWH is our lawgiver. YHWH is our Sovereign. YHWH will save us.

rows.before: Who has directed the Ruach of YHWH, or has taught him as his counselor?
rows.after: Who has directed the Ruach of YHWH, or has taught YHWH as YHWH’s counselor?

rows.before: To whom then will you liken Elohim? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
rows.after: To whom then will you liken Elohim? Or what likeness will you compare to Elohim?

rows.before: Produce your cause," says YHWH. "Bring forth your strong reasons," says the King of Ya'akov.
rows.after: Produce your cause," says YHWH. "Bring forth your strong reasons," says the Sovereign of Ya'akov.

rows.before: Sing to YHWH a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
rows.after: Sing to YHWH a new song, and YHWH’s praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.

rows.before: Let them give glory to YHWH, and declare his praise in the islands.
rows.after: Let them give glory to YHWH, and declare YHWH’s praise in the islands.

rows.before: I am YHWH, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King."
rows.after: I am YHWH, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your Sovereign."

rows.before: This is what YHWH, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, YHWH of Armies, says: "I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no Elohim.
rows.after: This is what YHWH, the Sovereign of Israel, and his Redeemer, YHWH of Armies, says: "I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no Elohim.

rows.before: They sang the song of Moshe, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, "Great and marvelous are your works, Sovereign God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
rows.after: They sang the song of Moshe, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, "Great and marvelous are your works, Sovereign God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you Sovereign of the nations.

rows.before: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Bavel the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
rows.after: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Bavel the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of God’s wrath.

rows.before: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn't turn back and give him glory.
rows.after: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn't turn back and give God glory.

rows.before: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. The one who sits on the throne will spread their tent over them.
rows.after: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve God day and night in God’s temple. The one who sits on the throne will spread their tent over them.

rows.before: Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to YHWH, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
rows.after: Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to YHWH, your God; for YHWH is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.

rows.before: "Be glad then, you children of Tzion, and rejoice in YHWH, your God; for he gives you the former rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the former rain and the latter rain, as before.
rows.after: "Be glad then, you children of Tzion, and rejoice in YHWH, your God; for YHWH gives you the former rain in just measure, and causes the rain to come down for you, the former rain and the latter rain, as before.
